# Hosts to skip in check-external-links.mjs.
#
# Only for hosts that refuse automated requests whatever the URL — so the check
# cannot tell a live page from a dead one and any result it gives is noise.
# Do NOT add a host just because one link under it broke; that is the check
# working.
#
# Empty on purpose. 429s are retried once with a backoff before being reported,
# which was enough for github.com.
